text: This application proposes to develop purpose built rental dwelling units in two blocks of townhouses and two apartment buildings on the lands municipally known as 111 Pacific Avenue, 255 Glenlake Avenue and 66 Oakmount Road. The townhouse blocks have a proposed height of 3-storeys. One apartment building has a proposed tower height of 33-storeys (108.4 metres, excluding mechanical penthouse) including a 3-storey base and the other apartment building has a proposed tower height of 29 storeys (94.4 metres, excluding mechanical penthouse) including an 8 storey base. The lands currently include three rental apartment buildings ranging in height from 12 to 23 storeys. The proposal would add 768 new rental units to the existing 750 rental units for a total of 1,518 dwelling units. The proposed development would maintain all existing on-site rental dwelling units.
